data.spec:
---
host: "lightapi.net"
service: "host"
schemas:
  getOrgRequest:
    title: "Org List"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      offset:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Record offset"
      limit:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Record limit"
      active:
        type: "boolean"
        description: "Active"
    required:
    - "limit"
    - "offset"
    - "active"
  getHostRequest:
    title: "Host List"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      offset:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Record offset"
      limit:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Record limit"
      active:
        type: "boolean"
        description: "Active"
    required:
    - "limit"
    - "offset"
    - "active"
  getHostByDomainRequest:
    title: "Host List"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      domain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Domain"
    required:
    - "domain"
  getFreshOrgRequest:
    title: "Org"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      domain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Domain"
      aggregateVersion:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Aggregate Version"
    required:
    - "domain"
    - "aggregateVersion"
  getFreshHostRequest:
    title: "Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
      aggregateVersion:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Aggregate Version"
    required:
    - "hostId"
    - "aggregateVersion"
  getHostByIdRequest:
    title: "Host Dashboard"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
    required:
    - "hostId"
  getHostDomainByIdRequest:
    title: "Host Domain"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
    required:
    - "hostId"
  getUserHostRequest:
    title: "User Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      offset:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Record offset"
      limit:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Record limit"
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
      active:
        type: "boolean"
        description: "Active"
    required:
    - "limit"
    - "offset"
    - "active"
    - "hostId"
  getOperationalStoreBindingsRequest:
    title: "Operational Store Bindings"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      targetHostId: {type: "string", format: "uuid"}
      bindingId: {type: "string", format: "uuid"}
      includeInactive: {type: "boolean", default: false}
    required: ["targetHostId", "includeInactive"]
action:
- name: "getOrg"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetOrg"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getOrgRequest"
    example:
      offset: 0
      limit: 10
      active: true
- name: "getHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetHost"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getHostRequest"
    example:
      offset: 0
      limit: 10
      active: true
- name: "getHostByDomain"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetHostByDomain"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getHostByDomainRequest"
    example:
      domain: "example.com"
- name: "getFreshOrg"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetFreshOrg"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getFreshOrgRequest"
    example:
      domain: "example.com"
      aggregateVersion: 1
- name: "getFreshHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetFreshHost"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getFreshHostRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
      aggregateVersion: 1
- name: "getHostLabel"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetHostLabel"
  skipAuth: true
  request:
    schema: null
- name: "getHostById"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetHostById"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getHostByIdRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
- name: "getHostDomainById"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetHostDomainById"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getHostDomainByIdRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
- name: "getUserHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetUserHost"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getUserHostRequest"
    example:
      offset: 0
      limit: 10
      active: true
      hostId: "host123"
- name: "getOperationalStoreBindings"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "GetOperationalStoreBindings"
  scope: "portal.r"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/getOperationalStoreBindingsRequest"

---
host: "lightapi.net"
service: "host"
schemas:
  createOrgRequest:
    title: "Create Org"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      domain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Domain Name"
        pattern: ".*\\S.*"
      orgName:
        type: "string"
        description: "Org Name"
        pattern: ".*\\S.*"
      orgDesc:
        type: "string"
        description: "Org Desc"
      orgOwner:
        type: "string"
        description: "Org Owner"
        pattern: ".*\\S.*"
      subDomain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Default Sub Domain"
        pattern: ".*\\S.*"
      hostDesc:
        type: "string"
        description: "Default Host Desc"
      hostOwner:
        type: "string"
        description: "Default Host Owner"
        pattern: ".*\\S.*"
    required:
    - "domain"
    - "orgName"
    - "orgOwner"
    - "subDomain"
    - "hostOwner"
  updateOrgRequest:
    title: "Update Org"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      domain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Domain Name"
      orgName:
        type: "string"
        description: "Org Name"
      orgDesc:
        type: "string"
        description: "Org Desc"
      orgOwner:
        type: "string"
        description: "Org Owner"
    required:
    - "domain"
    - "orgName"
    - "orgOwner"
  deleteOrgRequest:
    title: "Delete Org"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      domain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Domain Name"
    required:
    - "domain"
  createHostRequest:
    title: "Create Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      domain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Domain"
      subDomain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Sub Domain"
      hostDesc:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Desc"
      hostOwner:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Owner"
    required:
    - "domain"
    - "subDomain"
    - "hostOwner"
  updateHostRequest:
    title: "Update Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
      domain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Domain"
      subDomain:
        type: "string"
        description: "Sub Domain"
      hostDesc:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Desc"
      hostOwner:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Owner"
    required:
    - "hostId"
    - "domain"
    - "subDomain"
    - "hostOwner"
  deleteHostRequest:
    title: "Delete Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
    required:
    - "hostId"
  switchUserHostRequest:
    title: "Switch User Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
    required:
    - "hostId"
  createUserHostRequest:
    title: "Create User Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
      userId:
        type: "string"
        description: "User Id"
    required:
    - "hostId"
    - "userId"
  deleteUserHostRequest:
    title: "Delete User Host"
    type: "object"
    properties:
      hostId:
        type: "string"
        description: "Host Id"
      userId:
        type: "string"
        description: "User Id"
      aggregateVersion:
        type: "integer"
        description: "Aggregate Version"
    required:
    - "hostId"
    - "userId"
    - "aggregateVersion"
  operationalStoreRegistrationV2Request:
    title: "Register Operational Store Binding"
    type: "object"
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      targetHostId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
      engine: {type: "string", enum: ["POSTGRESQL"]}
      serverHost:
        type: "string"
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 253
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,251}[A-Za-z0-9])?$"
      port: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 65535}
      expectedDatabase: {type: "string", pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$"}
      tlsMode: {type: "string", enum: ["DISABLE", "PREFER", "REQUIRE", "VERIFY_CA", "VERIFY_FULL"]}
      credentialSource: {type: "string", enum: ["MOUNTED_FILE"]}
      credentialReference: {type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 512}
      minimumSchemaGeneration: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 9007199254740991}
      credentialGeneration: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 9007199254740991}
    required: ["targetHostId", "engine", "serverHost", "port", "expectedDatabase",
      "tlsMode", "credentialSource", "credentialReference",
      "minimumSchemaGeneration", "credentialGeneration"]
  operationalStoreUpdateV2Request:
    title: "Update Operational Store Binding"
    type: "object"
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      targetHostId: {type: "string", format: "uuid"}
      engine: {type: "string", enum: ["POSTGRESQL"]}
      serverHost:
        type: "string"
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 253
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,251}[A-Za-z0-9])?$"
      port: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 65535}
      expectedDatabase: {type: "string", pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$"}
      tlsMode: {type: "string", enum: ["DISABLE", "PREFER", "REQUIRE", "VERIFY_CA", "VERIFY_FULL"]}
      credentialSource: {type: "string", enum: ["MOUNTED_FILE"]}
      credentialReference: {type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 512}
      minimumSchemaGeneration: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 9007199254740991}
      credentialGeneration: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 9007199254740991}
      aggregateVersion: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 9007199254740991}
    required: ["targetHostId", "engine", "serverHost", "port", "expectedDatabase",
      "tlsMode", "credentialSource", "credentialReference",
      "minimumSchemaGeneration", "credentialGeneration", "aggregateVersion"]
  operationalStoreRegistrationActionV2Request:
    title: "Operational Store Registration Action"
    type: "object"
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      targetHostId: {type: "string", format: "uuid"}
      aggregateVersion: {type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 9007199254740991}
    required: ["targetHostId", "aggregateVersion"]
  operationalStoreBindingActionRequest:
    title: "Operational Store Binding Action"
    type: "object"
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      targetHostId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
      bindingId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
    required: ["targetHostId", "bindingId"]
  operationalStoreRetentionActionRequest:
    title: "Operational Store Retention Action"
    type: "object"
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      targetHostId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
      bindingId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
      retentionReason:
        type: "string"
        maxLength: 512
    required: ["targetHostId", "bindingId"]
  operationalStoreWorkerReportRequest:
    title: "Operational Store Worker Report"
    type: "object"
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      targetHostId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
      bindingId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
      failureCode:
        type: "string"
        pattern: "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_.-]{0,125}$"
      providerResourceRef:
        type: "string"
        maxLength: 512
      jobId:
        type: "string"
        format: "uuid"
      leaseOwner:
        type: "string"
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 126
      fencingToken:
        type: "integer"
        minimum: 1
    required: ["targetHostId", "bindingId", "jobId", "leaseOwner", "fencingToken"]
action:
- name: "createOrg"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "CreateOrg"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/createOrgRequest"
    example:
      domain: "example.com"
      orgName: "org name"
      orgDesc: "org description"
      orgOwner: "user123"
      subDomain: "test"
      hostDesc: "default host description"
      hostOwner: "user123"
- name: "updateOrg"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "UpdateOrg"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/updateOrgRequest"
    example:
      domain: "example.com"
      orgName: "org name"
      orgDesc: "org description"
      orgOwner: "user123"
- name: "deleteOrg"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "DeleteOrg"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/deleteOrgRequest"
    example:
      domain: "example.com"
- name: "createHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "CreateHost"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/createHostRequest"
    example:
      domain: "example.com"
      subDomain: "dev"
- name: "updateHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "UpdateHost"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/updateHostRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
      domain: "example.com"
      subDomain: "dev"
- name: "deleteHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "DeleteHost"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/deleteHostRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
- name: "switchUserHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "SwitchUserHost"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/switchUserHostRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
- name: "createUserHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "CreateUserHost"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/createUserHostRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
      userId: "user123"
- name: "deleteUserHost"
  version: "0.1.0"
  handler: "DeleteUserHost"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/deleteUserHostRequest"
    example:
      hostId: "host123"
      userId: "user123"
      aggregateVersion: 1
- name: "registerOperationalStoreBinding"
  version: "0.2.0"
  handler: "RegisterOperationalStoreBinding"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request:
    schema:
      $ref: "#/schemas/operationalStoreRegistrationV2Request"
- name: "updateOperationalStoreBinding"
  version: "0.2.0"
  handler: "UpdateOperationalStoreBinding"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request: {schema: {$ref: "#/schemas/operationalStoreUpdateV2Request"}}
- name: "deactivateOperationalStoreBinding"
  version: "0.2.0"
  handler: "DeactivateOperationalStoreRegistration"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request: {schema: {$ref: "#/schemas/operationalStoreRegistrationActionV2Request"}}
- name: "unregisterOperationalStoreBinding"
  version: "0.2.0"
  handler: "UnregisterOperationalStoreBinding"
  scope: "portal.w"
  request: {schema: {$ref: "#/schemas/operationalStoreRegistrationActionV2Request"}}
